statement: The record gives an amount due of USD 18,200.00 for bill EB-2209, despite the prior twelve bills ranging from USD 96 to USD 205.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the amount as contradicting the record's own data: "USD 18,200.00 ... despite the prior twelve bills ranging from USD 96 to USD 205."
